name: TvSeriesBinging_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are having a casual discussion about what TV series to watch.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation with alternating turns where users decide what tv series to binge together by discussing their preferences and sharing personal recommendations.

setting.background: They want something that keeps them engaged for weeks

scenario_template.topic: Defining what makes a good binge-worthy series
scenario_template.note: They mention episode length and number of seasons. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.

scenario_template.note: They recall past disappointments. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
